question: One RGB-only transform from pinned LDraw VALUE to three instruction face colors; no color-code lookup.
data: All10 base colors plus all3 previously measured new-color controls with verified identities. Retrospective, not prospective data.
inputs: Only normalized LDConfig VALUE RGB. No CODE/name/theme/measured face used as an input feature.
architectures: RGB to left then common left-to-top/right gains
ridge: Residual relative to identity; mean squared error per input row plus lambda times squared coefficients. All coefficients, including intercept, penalized. Shared-channel fits pool channels as rows. Features0..1.
selection: Nested leave-one-color-out: outer color excluded from both fitting and family/penalty selection. Inner held-out MAE selects one of54 candidates. Fixed-family results also select only penalty inside each outer fold. Final candidate selected using LOCO on all13; not evaluated by its training fit.
gate: Per-face outer MAE<=3 RGB and all channel errors<=10, inherited target from prior new-color protocol. No automatic default promotion.
sensitivity: Rerun complete nested procedure for9 joint +/-1-native-pixel shifts of output ROIs; shifts are not independent observations.
reporting: Report all14 architecture/family results, all13 predictions, maxima, exact source/hash/provenance, known-color geometry transfer. Failure of candidates is not a proof no function exists.
